rubric: The repro was actually run and went red on this symptom; its command is in `## Repro`
`## Cause` has one line, confidence, severity and owner; `## Evidence` lists every probe and the hypotheses dropped
The evidence you hold meets the minimum for the severity you claimed (the table in Rules and Guardrails)
`files` lists every file the fix will touch, and the owner matches where they live; with `owner: both`, `owner_files` gives each side its own files
`git diff` on source is empty and no `[DEBUG-` tag remains (`grep`)
Re-diagnose rounds: every `audit.missing` item is answered in `## Evidence` or its absence is explained
`fix.md` is ≤ 60 lines and only the diagnosis sections changed
The final message ends with a valid JSON hand-off block with a `diagnosis`

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix. Read: .team/fix-x/fix.md. Step 4a. Symptom: POST /contact returns 500 when message is empty, log TypeError at src/api/contact.ts:41.
must: runs or writes a failing test first
states one hypothesis and checks it against a second piece of evidence
rates a severity and names the owner
hand-off has step 4a and a known diagnosis with cause, files, repro, severity and owner

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix, step 4a. Symptom: login redirects to the old page after password reset. No log, cannot reproduce locally.
must: reports diagnosis status unknown with a reason naming the missing evidence

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix, step 4a. The root cause is that the response schema in contract.md is wrong and needs a migration.
Profile: fix, step 4a. Invoice totals are wrong for some customers (money). You hold one failing run and a suspect line.
must: rates the severity high or critical, not low
gathers the extra evidence that tier needs, or lowers the confidence and says what is missing
must_not: lowers the severity to make the audit easier
hands off known with only one failing run for a high severity

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix, step 4a round 2. Read: handoff/4b-auditor-r1.json whose audit.missing is ["run the repro for a second user"].
must: answers every audit.missing item in ## Evidence or says why it cannot
writes a new hand-off file for the round
